subject: NimbusAI term sheet — exclusivity, MFN and benchmark clauses (escalation)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: NimbusAI term sheet — exclusivity & benchmark asks

Team,

Sharing the latest term sheet from NimbusAI (attached). Key commercial asks that are outside our standard guardrails:

- 12-month exclusivity in the "advertising analytics" vertical (they want a clause that prevents us from selling the same features to strategic competitors in the sector).
- MFN: they want us to match any better pricing or commercial terms offered to other customers (broad language, no carve-outs).
- Benchmarks: a quarterly benchmark tied to model accuracy and uptime with a financial credit/penalty schedule.
- Request for a 15% first-year discount tied to an ARR commitment.

Why I'm escalating: Marissa flagged category risks and recommended redlines; Rishi flagged MFN/exclusivity as high legal/commercial risk. We need an executive decision on whether to:
  1) approve a limited concession (e.g., time-boxed exclusivity trial + narrow MFN carve-outs) and what discount cap to allow, or
  2) push back and walk away.

Attachments: NimbusAI-term-sheet-v3.pdf (customer), please review the term sheet and Marissa's notes when you can.

Next ask: Can we get a decision on the allowed discount and MFN/exclusivity tolerances by EOD Monday (2026-03-29)? I can coordinate a call with Nimbus if needed.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: NimbusAI-term-sheet-v3.pdf (pdf, 245KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T11:03:00Z
Subject: RE: NimbusAI term sheet — exclusivity & benchmark asks

Laura — thanks for the heads up and the term sheet. I read through the asks and drafted recommended redlines. High-level summary:

- Exclusivity (high risk): recommend rejecting any broad exclusivity. If we must concede, limit to a 90-day feature trial limited to the "predictive-ad-insights" module, with an explicit carve-out for public cloud resellers, marketplaces, and partners. Add automatic sunset at 90 days unless both parties mutually extend in writing.

- MFN (very high risk): recommend an MFN narrow to "negotiated commercial discounts for base subscription fees" and explicitly exclude promotional, temporary, or self-service pricing and exclude open-source/OSS projects. Also require notice and an opportunity to cure.

- Benchmark/penalties: accept a performance SLA but cap financial credits to a single quarter's subscription and require objective, mutually agreed measurement methods. No automatic price deduction beyond the cap.

- Discount: recommend approval authority at 10% for Sales Manager, anything >10% requires exec approval. Given the strategic nature of the account and ARR ask, propose a one-time 10% introductory discount + performance-based expansion clause.

I've attached a tracked redline (redlines_nimbusai_v1.docx) with specific language. I suggest we escalate MFN + exclusivity to execs / legal for explicit sign-off if they insist on the language.

Marissa
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_nimbusai_v1.docx (docx, tracked changes)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T08:21:00Z
Subject: RE: NimbusAI term sheet — exclusivity & benchmark asks

Laura / Marissa — I reviewed both the term sheet and Marissa's redlines. Legal view: MFN + exclusivity as proposed constitute material competitive restrictions and exposure we should not accept without executive waiver and specific mitigations. Specific points:

1) MFN: Broad MFN language creates downstream pricing parity obligations and can force us to disclose pricing terms internally or to third parties. If we must agree, the clause must be: (a) narrowly scoped to subscription list prices for equivalent customer segments, (b) exclude temporary promotions/partner discounts, and (c) include a notice and cure window. Avoid any requirement to retroactively apply future commercial concessions.

2) Exclusivity: A 12-month blanket exclusivity in a horizontal market is a deal killer for us. If approval is granted, it must be strictly time-limited (90 days max), feature-specific, and include a termination for material breach clause. Also add a carve-out preserving sales to existing customers and public cloud marketplaces.

3) Benchmark credits: Caps only. No open-ended penalties. Recommend a maximum refund cap equal to three months' subscription and require independent measurement (third-party or mutually agreed telemetry) to trigger credits.

I have prepared a short legal risk memo with suggested alternative language and rationale (legal_risk_memo.txt). Legal cannot sign the final contract if the MFN or exclusivity language remains in the current broad form. We can accept a narrow, documented exception approved by the executive team.

Rishi Malhotra
General Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-27T16:40:00Z
Subject: Exec summary: NimbusAI — recommended limited concessions for close

Tessa — quick executive summary and recommendation. Customer is high strategic value (customer in adtech with potential for 3x expansion in 18 months). They are asking for three primary concessions: exclusivity (12 months), MFN (broad), and a performance benchmark with credit schedule.

Recommended route to close:
- Approve a one-time commercial concession: 10% first-year discount (non-recurring) tied to a 12-month ARR commit. Anything above 10% requires explicit approval.
- Exclusivity: Approve a 90-day feature-specific exclusivity trial limited to the "predictive-ad-insights" module only, with a mandatory sunset and carve-outs for marketplaces and existing customers.
- MFN: Approve only if narrowed per Legal's redline: exclude promotions, require notice/cure, and limit to comparable customers (no retroactive repricing).
- Benchmarks: Accept with a cap (three months' subscription) and objective measurement.

If you approve, Legal will prepare the addendum with the narrowed MFN and exclusivity language and Deal Desk will formalize the discount/terms. We need your explicit sign-off to proceed; please reply with APPROVE or REJECT and any edits by EOD 2026-03-29.

Attached: exec_summary_nimbus.txt (one-pager).

Vivek
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-03-29T09:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Exec summary: NimbusAI — recommended limited concessions for close

Vivek / team — APPROVE, with the following constraints:

1) Discount: Approve the 10% one-time discount only. Any incremental commercial levers must be negotiated as performance-based clauses (not upfront).
2) Exclusivity: Approve 90-day feature trial only. No renewal of exclusivity without explicit exec approval. Add a clause that allows Redwood to continue selling to existing customers and marketplace partners.
3) MFN: Approve conditioned on Legal's redline (Rishi) including explicit carve-outs for promotions/partner pricing, and a 30-day notice + cure period. No retroactive price adjustments.
4) Benchmarks: Approve with a cap of three months' subscription and require objective, auditable measurement.

Please ensure Legal drafts the exact addendum and Sales gets counter-signature within 7 business days. Laura — send a firm counter with these concessions and attach the addendum once Legal prepares it.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T14:17:00Z
Subject: RE: NimbusAI term sheet — revised commercial offer

Aisha — thanks for the patience. Following internal review, Redwood can proceed with the following limited concessions:

1) Discount: one-time 10% first-year discount tied to the ARR commitment (as discussed).
2) Exclusivity: a 90-day, feature-specific exclusivity trial limited to the "predictive-ad-insights" module. Carve-outs: public cloud marketplaces, resellers, and existing customers are excluded. Exclusivity sunsets automatically unless both parties agree in writing to extend.
3) MFN: Redwood agrees to a narrow MFN limited to list subscription pricing for comparable customers. MFN explicitly excludes temporary promotions, partner-specific discounts, and open-source/community pricing. Customer will notify Redwood in writing of any claimed MFN trigger and Redwood will have a 30-day cure period. No retroactive price adjustments.
4) Benchmarks & credits: We accept an objective benchmark with a credit cap of three months' subscription; measurement will be based on mutually agreed telemetry.

Rishi will prepare a short addendum reflecting the exact language for the MFN, exclusivity carve-outs, and benchmark caps. Once drafted I'll send it to your procurement team for review.

If this aligns, can we schedule a 30-minute call this week to finalize language?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
